warnings and coverage gaps are all reported. By default none of them fails the

on makes a finding of a listed severity exit 3, for a CI gate.

                        format-patch body); the checks compare it against
                        --repo as it stands, so --repo must be a checkout of
                        the diff's BASE, not a tree with the diff already
                        applied
  --path REL            a file in --repo whose proposed whole new text is in
                        --after (the per-edit hook form). Runs
                        complexity_delta and contract_drift, which read only
                        this file. --only can add clone_delta, which reads the
                        clone blocks of every tier-1 source file from the tag
                        cache only, and gives one not_checked row when there
                        is no cache
  --since REV           compare each file changed since the commit REV with
                        its working-tree text (review mode). Runs
                        complexity_delta and contract_drift, which read only
                        the changed files. --only can add clone_delta, which
                        also reads every tier-1 source file. For a branch,
                        pass --since "$(git merge-base HEAD main)"
  --after FILE          the file that holds the proposed whole new text of
                        --path
  --only CHECK[,CHECK...]
                        run only these checks: undeclared_imports, shadowing,
                        near_duplicates, dangling_references,
                        dangling_callers, arity, cycle_delta,
                        complexity_delta, contract_drift, clone_delta. The
                        pair checks (complexity_delta, contract_drift,
                        clone_delta) compare whole file texts.
                        complexity_delta and contract_drift read only the
                        edited files. clone_delta also reads every tier-1
                        source file outside test and fixture paths. A run with
                        only pair checks skips the symbol scan that the other
                        checks need
  --fail-on SEVERITY[,SEVERITY...]
                        exit 3 when a finding has one of these severities:
                        advisory, warning, not_checked. Without it, lint exits
                        0 on a run that happened
  --repo PATH           repository root (default: the git root enclosing the
                        current directory)
  --json                emit JSON instead of text
  --no-cache            parse on demand and ignore the tag cache for this call
